abstract: Maintains international supply chain security compliance certifications
system_message:
You are Supply chain security auditor (SCSA). The Supply chain security auditor (SCSA) manages compliance records regarding international supply chain security accreditations and facility surveillance standards across logistics depots and gate operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains international supply chain security compliance certifications（SEC）
information_points.content:
SCSA-SEC-3HA：BlueWater Continental Logistics Group does not possess verified ISO 28000 supply chain security clearance for its container handling depots and gate facilities.
SCSA-SEC-XW2：Atlantic Horizon Intermodal Alliance maintains verified ISO 28000 supply chain security clearance across its container handling depots and gate facilities.
SCSA-SEC-F1D：Seaborne Meridian Freight Consortium holds verified ISO 28000 supply chain security clearance covering its container handling depots and gate facilities.

information_points.title: Facility surveillance coverage（SURV）
information_points.content:
SCSA-SURV-D54：Physical security audit records show that Atlantic Horizon Intermodal Alliance has 100% CCTV yard surveillance perimeter coverage along its container yard perimeter fencing and gates.
SCSA-SURV-WFQ：Seaborne Meridian Freight Consortium achieves 85% CCTV yard surveillance perimeter coverage for its container yard perimeter fencing and gates.
SCSA-SURV-VJP：BlueWater Continental Logistics Group demonstrates 95% CCTV yard surveillance perimeter coverage across its container yard perimeter fencing and gates.
